aliases: []

requirementsZh:
1. 選出五個聖經故事，說出它們在聖經中的位置。
2. 你選出的故事人物是如何表明他們愛或不愛耶穌？
3. 講故事時，要記得的三件重要事情。

frontmatter:
id: hka4070-bread-of-life
code: HKA4070
nameZh: "生命之糧"
nameEn: "Bread of Life"
aliases: []
category: spiritual
answerSource: draft
status: non-review
requirementsZh:
1. 翻開、閱讀並寫出馬太福音 4:4。 與成人討論它的重要性，並寫下你所學到的。
2. 與成人討論每天閱讀上帝的話的重要性，並寫下你的結論。
3. 翻開並閱讀提摩太後書 2:15、詩篇 119:11 和詩篇 119:105。我們為什麼要研讀聖經？
4. 討論如何準備自己閱讀上帝的話語。 寫下四個有關學習聖經的習慣。
5. 閱讀以下其中一個聖經故事。
   a. 哈拿祈求兒子 - 撒母耳記上 1:1-28
   b. 挪亞方舟 - 創世記 6:5-創世記 8
   c. 嬰孩摩西 - 出埃及記 1-2:10
   d. 長大麻瘋的乃縵 – 列王記下 5:1-16
6. 製作一張書籤，並在研讀聖經時使用。
7. 定期花時間閱讀聖經。

answersEn.en: Read the text slow enough for the children to write it down. Ask them questions to promote discussion. a. Who do you think said it? Answer: Jesus said it. He was speaking to Satan. b. What do you think it means? Answer: Satan was tempting Jesus, trying to get Him to eat. Jesus replied by letting him know that prayer and meditating on God’s Word is just as essential to living as is food for our physical needs. Note: Read Matthew 4:1-4 to show the full meaning of the text.

It is important for us to read our Bibles every day in order to ensure our relationship with our Heavenly Father stays strong. Reading His Word and praying helps strengthen our bond and increases our chances to share Him with others.
Find additional verses.

Four Bible study habits. a. To set aside time every morning or every evening. b. Start with a prayer before you begin your study. Ask the Holy Spirit to be with you as you read and help you understand. “Scripture can only be understood thro’ the same Spirit whereby it was given.” ~John Wesley. c. Be sure to pause during your reading. Think about what you have read and how you can apply it to your life and your journey with Christ. d. Your reading should be closed with prayer asking God to help you remember the message and hold it in your heart.
Or read other Bible verses.
Use cardstock.
Encourage adults to model regular Bible study as a lifelong habit. The skills learned for this award could be taught every year.

frontmatter:
id: hka4074-good-samaritan
code: HKA4074
nameZh: "好撒馬利亞人"
nameEn: "Good Samaritan"
aliases: []
category: spiritual
answerSource: draft
status: non-review
requirementsZh:
1. 有需要是什麼意思？
2. 聖經對那些幫助有需要的人有什麼應許？
3. 閱讀並討論馬太福音 25：35-40。
4. 有哪些機構可以幫助有需要的人？
5. 你所屬的教會如何幫助有需要的人？
6. 討論可以幫助有需要的人的方法。
7. 參加兩項活動並幫助有需要的人，例如：◼ 幫助社區中有需要的家庭◼ 為無家者提供食物◼ 為食品捐贈或食物銀行的無家者收容所收集罐頭食品◼ 在無家者收容所或城市食品儲藏室做義工◼ 參加衣物募捐活動，分發毯子和/或襪子等。◼ 其他。
8. 討論活動中得到的經驗。

answersEn.en: Age appropriate discussion that might include food, shelter, clothing, water, transportation, blankets, etc.
For example: Prov 28:27, 1 John 3:17, Prov 19:17, 1 Samuel 2:8, Prov. 21:13, or Matthew 5:3.
Encourage discussion.
Adventist Community Service, Dorcus, ADRA, Red Cross, Salvation Army, Samaritan Purse, Local food banks.
Invite several church members to share with the club how and who they help.
Such as, collect cloths, food, help with finding shelter; participate in a fundraiser for a family or an agency.
Obtain proper authorization, permission, applicable permits and insurance to do the chosen activity.
Follow event with a lively discussion.

frontmatter:
id: hka4075-jesus-special-supper
code: HKA4075
nameZh: "耶穌的特別晚餐"
nameEn: "Jesus' Special Supper"
aliases: []
category: spiritual
answerSource: draft
status: non-review
requirementsZh:
1. 講述最後晚餐的故事。
2. 解釋為什麼耶穌成為僕人為門徒洗腳。
3. 解釋無酵餅和葡萄汁代表什麼。
4. 特別晚餐結束時發生了什麼？（約翰福音 14－17 章）
5. 禱告感謝耶穌的愛。
6. 製作一件有關最後晚餐的勞作。

answersEn.en: Mark Chapter 14 and Luke 22:17-20 - Try to impress on the children that Jesus knew this was the last time they would be together before He died so He wanted to make a Special Supper for them. Bring in some sandals or flip flops and discuss why feet need to be washed. You may want to let the children walk in some dirt or mud and share with them that most of the roads in Jesus’s day were not paved and would be dirt or mud.
John 13:12-14 - Explain that we are to wash each other’s feet to show we are humble and no better than anyone else. Try to impress on the children that we should be a servant like Jesus was.
Bread represents Jesus’s body and the grape juice represents His blood.
They sang a hymn and went out. John 14-17 is Jesus’ last words, potentially in the upper room, or on the trip to the Mount of Olives.
Read Matthew 26:30 and sing a hymn.
Use Google or Pinterest “Last supper craft” for ideas.

frontmatter:
id: hka4081-purity
code: HKA4081
nameZh: "純潔"
nameEn: "Purity"
aliases: []
category: spiritual
answerSource: draft
status: non-review
requirementsZh:
1. 純潔（或敬虔）是什麼？
2. 閱讀腓立比書 4:8-9 並用泥膠或黏土製作以下內容，同時舉例說明。
   a. 眼睛
   b. 耳朵
   c. 嘴
   d. 衣服
3. 說出聖經中一位無論發生什麼事都選擇跟隨上帝的女人。
4. 說出聖經中一個無論發生什麼事都選擇跟隨上帝的男人。
5. 寫出三節聖經經文，說明上帝如何幫助你變得純潔（或敬虔）。
6. 參與一個與敬虔思想有關的遊戲。當你播下思想的種子時，你就會收穫一種感覺。當你種下一種感覺，你就會收穫一種行動。 當你播下一種行動的種子時，你就會收穫一種習慣。當你播下一種習慣，你就會收穫一種性格。 當你播下一種性格，你就會收穫一種命運。
7. 閱讀歌羅西書 3:12-14。 解釋穿上愛心是什麼意思。（見加拉太書 5：22-23）。
8. 閱讀提摩太前書 4:12、約伯記 17:9 和但以理書 1-3 章。 製作一張海報來說明：當你要做出重大改變，永遠不會太遲；當你選擇純潔（或敬虔）時，你會變得越來越強大。
9. 閱讀馬可福音 2:1-12。 製作一張海報，說明四位朋友如何把他們生病的朋友放在床上，然後用繩子從屋頂把他放下來，以便耶穌醫治他。 朋友可以幫助我們保持純潔（或敬虔）。

answersEn.en: Have the children write the following sentences: Purity is avoiding things that take you away from God. Purity is spiritual and grows from inside out. It is not a costume but a way of living. The music you listen to, the books you read, the videos you watch, and the clothes you wear should be pure/ modest. When you live a life of purity, the rewards last forever.
Try edible play dough, if available. Search the Internet for a recipe.
Jesus’ mother Mary remained pure, despite the ridicule she received from those around her. She trusted the words of God.

Daniel helped give an entire kingdom the opportunity to pray to the living God. He was smart and that helped him successfully work for the king, but it was his character and loyalty to God that saved his life.

Explain to the children that because the Bible and its promises are so powerful, it can be used to keep you pure. A nice way to explain it simply to the Adventurers is that when you carry the Bible Satan gets nervous; when you open the Bible, Satan gets a headache; when he sees you reading the Bible, he faints; and when he sees you are living what you read, he flees. God’s word is armor for daily living.

Encourage the children to grow godly thoughts. Have the children stack crackers in the shape of a pyramid. Each cracker is a word. Use the words in the poem. The bottom of the pyramid would have the words/crackers: thought, feeling, action. The second level would have the words/crackers: habit, character. The top/third level would have the word/cracker: destiny.

Write out with big, open letters the word LOVE. Put the following words inside the word love: mercy, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience. Add any other virtuous words the children come up with. Decorate with vivid colors. Turn into a poster or t-shirt. If doing a t-shirt, then draw on a t-shirt transfer form or cut out a body from paper. Write the word mercy on one arm. Write the word kindness on the other arm. Write the word humility on the chest. Write the word gentleness on one leg. Write the word patience on the other leg. Make a sleeveless vest out of paper and write the word love on it and then place it on the cut-out body.

Make a fiery furnace poster. Write Job 17:9 at the bottom of the poster. Use cotton balls for framing the oven. Use strips of red tissue paper for fire. Put three smiling faces of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego in the fire.

Make a friend poster with the names of the people you will pray for to stay pure. Place a heart on the poster and put all the names of the people you care for inside the heart. Put rope/yarn around the heart. Encourage and pray for everyone in the heart.

frontmatter:
id: hka4082-tabernacle
code: HKA4082
nameZh: "會幕"
nameEn: "Tabernacle"
aliases: []
category: spiritual
answerSource: draft
status: non-review
requirementsZh:
1. 閱讀並討論哥林多前書 6:19，閱讀並討論出埃及記 25:8 和 29:44-46。
2. 會幕是什麼？
3. 列出會幕的三個主要區域。
4. 翻開並閱讀約翰福音 14:6、約翰福音 10:9 和馬太福音 7:13-14。 使用這些經文，討論門象徵什麼？ （大門代表基督）
5. 討論並分辨會幕及其他部分。
   a. 銅祭壇
   b. 會幕獻祭
   c. 洗濯盆
   d. 七燈臺
   e. 放陳設餅的桌子
   f. 香壇
   g. 至聖所與幔子
   h. 約櫃
6. 製作一個會幕模型。
7. 唱一首有關聖所的詩歌。
8. 參與以下其中一個遊戲：
   a. 會幕記憶。
   b. 混亂會幕的設施和名稱。
   c. 製作設施卡片； 將卡片混合起來，當他們抽出一張卡片時，將其放在會幕圖上的正確位置。
   d. 每個幼鋒會會員輪流抽出一張卡片，上面寫著會幕的一部分，然後站在房間裡的正確位置。
   e. 其他遊戲

answersEn.en: As you review the stories, emphasize the items built and encourage the children to discuss the choices the Bible characters made. a. God asked Noah to build an ark. It took Noah 120 years to build the ark and he lived on it for more than one year. Extra: How big was the ark? Use a long measuring tape to find out. b. Babel—God knew the best thing for the people at that time was to live in tents so they could spread across the earth—not to build the tower of Babel. c. Abram’s home was a tent. Extra: Make Abram’s tent out of sheets and chairs. d. God asked Moses to build a portable tabernacle. e. God asked Solomon to build a tabernacle in Jerusalem. f. God sent Joseph and Mary to a stable. g. At the end of the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus refers to a man who built a house by first laying a strong foundation on a rock. h. God wants you to live in the house He is building for you in heaven.

Questions you might ask: What materials do you build with? How do you know where to build? What is this tool used for? What do you need to learn to be a good builder? Alternatives: take a trip to a construction site, interview a workman and ask questions about the building.

Ways to share choices (you may work in teams): a. Draw a brick wall on a poster and write one choice or characteristic on each brick. b. Mime or act out a choice. c. Illustrate a choice in a painting, drawing, sculpture, or on a computer, video or camera. d. Sing a song describing good character-building choices. e. Privately, write a poem or journal, reflecting on your choice.
Bring gemstones to touch and see or show pictures of the New Jerusalem. Page 47

Any type of building materials may be used, such as toys like Lego, Lincoln Logs, or Tinker Toys, or craft sticks, play dough, foam board, or construction paper. Real building materials such as sticks, straw, mud, or bricks may also be used. Suggestions for types of buildings: Bible buildings, your home, school, favorite shop, church, imagined heavenly home.

frontmatter:
id: you4545-bible-royalty
code: YOU4545
nameZh: "聖經皇族"
nameEn: "Bible Royalty"
aliases: []
category: spiritual
answerSource: draft
status: non-review
requirementsZh:
1. 背誦詩篇 100：4。
2. 說出聖經中五個國王的名字。哪些國王是最好的統治者？為什麼？
3. 請講述兩個國王的故事，讓孩子們演出這兩個故事。
4. 能列出至少四個聖經故事裡皇后的名字。為什麼這些皇后那麼重要？
5. 寫一篇關於皇后的故事，並且在課堂中閱讀出來。
6. 做到下列兩項要求：
   a. 用一個鞋盒做一個皇宮
   b. 做一個王冠，並解釋王冠上的裝飾對國王有什麼含意
   c. 裝飾一把國王的椅子
   d. 做一幅王宮的壁畫
   e. 其他

answersEn.en: “Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name. For the LORD is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.”

First king – Saul; second king – David; third king – Solomon. Joash was seven years old when he started his reign; Josiah was eight when he became king, King Jesus, etc. These are just a few examples, list more if possible.
Use costumes, crowns, throne chair, etc. if possible.
Vashti, Esther, Bathsheba, Queen of Sheba, Jezebel, etc.
May work in small groups to write the story, then share the story with the class.
Use Bible story books for picture ideas. Possibilities include throne, carpet, pictures, vases, jewels, velvet, etc.

frontmatter:
id: you4630-disciples
code: YOU4630
nameZh: "門徒"
nameEn: "Disciples"
aliases: []
category: spiritual
answerSource: draft
status: non-review
requirementsZh:
1. 什麼是門徒？
2. 用聖經找出門徒的名字和職業，然後將名字和職業分別寫在一張紙卡上（太10：2-4，可 3：14-19，路 6:13-16，約 1：41-48） 。把這些紙卡混在一起，看看你能否把名字和職業正確地配對起來。
3. 說出門徒中的二對兄弟（參考太 10：2）。
4. 請說出第一個被耶穌呼召成為門徒的人。能夠從聖經章節中知道，在他發現耶穌就是彌賽亞時，他做了什麼事（約 1：35-42）。
5. 門徒求耶穌教導他們什麼？（路 11：1）
6. 一起誦讀主禱文。
7. 選出三位門徒，並說出你從他們身上學到了什麼。
8. 唱一首有關門徒的詩歌，或演出一個相關的短劇。
9. 成為耶穌的門徒。

answersEn.en: One who is a student or follower of a teacher’s doctrines or school of thought.

Andrew, Simon (Peter), James, John, Philip, Nathaniel (Bartholomew), Matthew (Levi), Thomas, James, Simon, Judas, and Judas Iscariot. We do not know the occupations of all the disciples. What do you think they did?
Peter and Andrew; James and John, the sons of Zebedee or the “Sons of Thunder.”
Andrew was called first to follow Jesus. He ran to get his brother so he could become a disciple of Jesus also.
The disciples asked Jesus to teach them to pray.
See resources.

“There Were 12 Disciples” song in “Sing for Joy” page 53. “Peter James and John in a Sailboat”, CD by Cedarmont Kids. Track eight on “Little David Presents Bible Songs” CD by Christian Songs for Kids.
Perform an act of kindness, such as preparing packages for the homeless.

frontmatter:
id: you4675-friend-of-jesus
code: YOU4675
nameZh: "耶穌之友"
nameEn: "Friend of Jesus"
aliases: []
category: spiritual
answerSource: draft
status: non-review
requirementsZh:
1. 對一位好朋友傳講耶穌，並且述說衪對你的慈愛。
2. 邀請一個朋友參加一次教會的聚會。
3. 請一位大人來協助你預備可在安息日學、或是幼年團聚會、或是學校分享的一個見證或一個禱告。
4. 參加一次佈道活動（信徒佈道或見證）
5. 參觀一次浸禮並討論受洗的意義。
6. 請解釋成為耶穌的好朋友是什麼意思，並且能說出聖經中五位耶穌的朋友。
7. 與家人談話時保持仁慈有禮。討論變得仁慈有禮就等於是與耶穌成為好友。
8. 實行飯前及睡前祈禱。

answersEn.en: Help the Adventurers learn to verbalize their love for Jesus and to share that love with others. Encourage them to pray simple prayers to express their love for Jesus (also for point number 8).

Encourage the Adventurers to invite a non-SDA friend. Discuss how they can be a good example by sitting quietly in church, walking softly, whispering only, singing, kneeling for prayer, being kind, etc.
Help the Adventurers prepare a simple talk appropriate for their age group; encourage their own ideas.
Talk with your pastor and get involved in outreach programs of your church.
Explain the reasons for baptism and tell the Adventurers that it was Jesus’ example for us. See that each child has the opportunity to attend a baptismal service.
Children may list Jesus’ disciples or other friends such as Mary, Martha, Lazarus, etc. To be a friend of Jesus means to accept His friendship and love and to share both with others.
Jesus knows our thoughts and actions. Because He loves us, we love Him and everything He has made, including our families and friends. Expressing kindness to others is showing our love for Jesus.
Teach the Adventurers the basic elements of prayer, including praise, thanksgiving, cleansing from sin, commitment, etc.

3. 依照你選擇的聖靈果子，從聖經當中找出一個描述其意義的故事，並且演出。

7. 依照你選擇的聖靈果子，製作一個能代表其意義、或能幫助你更了解其中意義的手工品。

answersEn.en: The fruits are: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.
Check in your Bible concordance.
Steve Green has a tape entitled “Hide ‘em in Your Heart.”

frontmatter:
id: you4805-my-church
code: YOU4805
nameZh: "我的教會"
nameEn: "My Church"
aliases: []
category: spiritual
answerSource: draft
status: non-review
requirementsZh:
1. 理解並背誦哥林多前書 3:16，並學習詩歌 “Lord, Prepare Me to Be aSanctuary”。
2. 知道你教會的名稱，並寫下教會的地址。 身為一名會員，請在牆上畫出與教會為中心的圖畫，把每個與教會有關的復臨信徒家庭畫上去，標示出道路和街道的名稱，就像是在畫一張教會地圖一樣。
3. 誰是你的教會傳道人？他/她的職責是什麼？請詢問他/她以下的問題。
   a. 你為什麼決定成為一名傳道人？
   b. 你是在幾歲的時候決定成為傳道人的？
   c. 在你的生命中發生了什麼事情使你想成為一名傳道人呢？
   d. 如果上帝呼召我，我可以成為傳道人嗎？
   e. 我怎樣才能為侍奉上帝的生活做好準備？
   f. 我現在要怎麼成為佈道士？
4. 畫出你教會的平面圖。如果你的教會有以下項目，請在地圖上標示出來。
   a. 聖所
   b. 教會辦公室
   c. 你的安息日學課室
   d. 多用途活動室
   e. 洗手間
   f. 幼鋒會房間
   g. 社區服務的房間

answersEn.en: Exodus 25:8
Parents should help their children.
Make a list of questions for your pastor prior to arrival. Examples are listed.

Leader, give the Adventurers a tour of the church. Then have the Adventurers act as tour guides to the different rooms or areas of the church. Next, ask the Adventurers to label a pre-drawn map of the church inserting the different rooms into the correct localities.

Invite the pastor and board members to model a board meeting during an Adventurer club meeting. Optional – role-play a board meeting using a child- friendly agenda. Ask the Adventurers to pretend to be adults sitting as active members on a board. Optional – have a staff meeting so the Adventurers may see all that goes into getting a meeting ready for them. (Suggestion: On the Adventurer Sabbath, say “Thank you for guiding our church.”)

answersEn.en: Help the Adventurers learn to verbalize their love for Jesus and to share that love with others. Encourage them to pray simple prayers to express their love for Jesus (also for point number 8).

Encourage the Adventurers to invite a non-SDA friend. Discuss how they can be a good example by sitting quietly in church, walking softly, whispering only, singing, kneeling for prayer, being kind, etc.
Help the Adventurers prepare a simple talk appropriate for their age group; encourage their own ideas.
Talk with your pastor and get involved in outreach programs of your church.
Explain the reasons for baptism and tell the Adventurers that it was Jesus’ example for us. See that each child has the opportunity to attend a baptismal service.
Children may list Jesus’ disciples or other friends such as Mary, Martha, Lazarus, etc. To be a friend of Jesus means to accept His friendship and love and to share both with others.
Jesus knows our thoughts and actions. Because He loves us, we love Him and everything He has made, including our families and friends. Expressing kindness to others is showing our love for Jesus.
Teach the Adventurers the basic elements of prayer, including praise, thanksgiving, cleansing from sin, commitment, etc.

Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet. An easy way to remember the order is to think of the order as a man’s name—Roy G. Biv. a. The following are the colors and examples of God’s awesome character: Red—Redeemer—Ephesians 1:7. Orange—Offering—John 1:29. The Lamb was a sacrifice offering for sin. Yellow—YEAH! —God is always cheering for us. He is always there cheering for us. (Example: The Lost Coin, Luke 15:8-10) Green—Giving—John 3:16. Blue—BIG—Our God is awesome (Example: Moses and the Red Sea) Indigo—Immanuel—Matt. 1:23. Violet—Victorious—Psalm 60:12. b. 7. 瞭解救恩的步驟：
   a. 神就是愛（約翰一書 4：8） 。上帝非常愛我（耶31:3） 。上帝愛每一個人（約翰 3:16）。
   b. 我是個罪人。每個人都會犯錯，且都是罪人，所以每一個人都需要救恩，因為罪人會帶來永遠的死亡(羅馬書 3:23)。
   c. 因為上帝差遣耶穌死在十架上，所以我就不用面對永遠的死亡(約3:16） 。然後，祂又從死裡復活成為我的救主(林前 5：3--4） 。當我接受耶穌時，我所有的罪將得到赦免（羅 3:23）
   d. 救恩是上帝給我的禮物。我必須邀請耶穌成為我個人的救主。
   e. (約 1:12) 當我祈禱時，上帝會垂聽我的祈禱。
   f. 如果我接受了耶穌，就會成為一個新造的人，成為一個不會想要再犯錯的人，因為我愛耶穌，耶穌也愛我(約翰福音 3：3-7；林後 5:17）。
   g. 我可以確定，只要求耶穌成為我的救主，就可以得救（約翰 3:26；來13：5） 。因為我是個罪人，我仍舊還會再犯錯，但是如果我向耶穌認罪，祂必會饒恕我，並且完全消除我的罪惡(耶利米書 31:34)。當我的行為傷害了別人時，上帝要我跟他認錯（約翰一書 1：9） ，並且賠償他們（路加福音 19：8） ，這樣就能完全脫離罪惡了(約翰福音 8:11)。
8. 閱讀下列四個聖經故事並且與大人討論他們所說談論的內容／救恩：
   a. 衣索匹亞人(埃提阿伯)的改變(使徒行傳 8:26-40）

   c. 耶穌愛孩童(馬太福音 19:13-15)
   d. 失落的錢幣、迷失的羊和浪子回頭(路加福音 15）

answersEn.en: Make these concepts as simple as needed for the child to grasp. The most important concept is that she/he recognize the nature of sin (wrongdoing) and its consequences (eternal death), and that they ask Jesus to forgive and be his/her Savior.

Encourage a planned, regular time with God—can be with parent, family worship, club, or alone. Commitment is key.

Personal commitment in young children is often spontaneous and publicly shown. But this award encourages a personal decision made contemplatively at home with parents. However, when a home-inspired decision is not possible, a teacher or other caring individual may be the best one to nurture this first step as privately as possible. Warmly welcome the child as the newest member of the family of God, assuring them of God’s unfailing love, acceptance, forgiveness, and great care. An extra project is recommended. Encourage the child to further respond in their own way—create a song, poem, painting, drawing, sculpture, or express themselves with video, camera, or computer (but never force).
